title: Count your taps
detail: Pick one app you open out of habit. Next time, pause for one breath and decide whether you actually want to.

title: Read one setting
detail: Open Settings and read one screen you've never looked at. What does it do?

title: Tidy one screen
detail: Remove or file three apps from your Home Screen that you haven't opened this month.

title: Spot the oldest idea
detail: Find an icon on your phone that pictures an object nobody uses any more.

title: Find a typeface you'd change
detail: Look at one sign near you. What would you change about its lettering, and why?

title: Door detective
detail: Notice the next door you use. Did its handle tell you whether to push or pull?

title: Redraw an icon
detail: Sketch a simpler version of any icon you can see. Thirty seconds, no erasing.

title: Three colours
detail: Name the three colours that dominate the room you're in. Do they work together?

title: One page
detail: Open any book near you to a random page and read just that page.

title: First line
detail: Write the opening sentence of a novel you'll never write.

title: Shelf check
detail: Find a book you own but haven't read. Read its first paragraph.

title: Borrowed words
detail: Look up where one word you used today comes from.

title: Sky report
detail: Look up. What kind of clouds are there, and which way are they moving?

title: Kitchen physics
detail: Drop a little oil into a glass of water and watch what it does. Why?

title: Shadow length
detail: Notice your shadow. Is it longer or shorter than you? What does that say about the sun?

title: Estimate it
detail: Guess how many steps it is to the nearest door. Then count.

title: Oldest thing here
detail: Find the oldest object within reach. How old do you think it is?

title: This day
detail: Ask someone older than you what they remember about a year you choose.

title: Street name
detail: Read the name of a nearby street. Who or what is it named after?

title: Tiny time capsule
detail: Write one sentence about today that you'd want to read in ten years.

title: Thirty-second gallery
detail: Look at one picture on a wall near you for a full thirty seconds. What did you miss before?

title: Blind contour
detail: Draw your hand without looking at the paper.

title: One whole song
detail: Listen to one song from start to finish and do nothing else.

title: Frame it
detail: Make a frame with your fingers and find one view worth keeping.

title: Balance test
detail: Stand on one leg for thirty seconds, then switch. Hold onto something if you need to.

title: Stairs, once
detail: Take the stairs once today where you'd usually take the lift.

title: One rule
detail: Look up one rule of a sport you watch but have never really understood.

title: Stretch tall
detail: Reach both arms overhead, breathe slowly five times, and let your shoulders drop.

title: Name a tree
detail: Find the nearest tree. What shape are its leaves? Do you know its name?

title: Birdsong minute
detail: Stand still outside or by a window for one minute and count the different bird calls.

title: Sky break
detail: Look at the sky for a full minute without your phone in your hand.

title: Small world
detail: Look closely at one square foot of ground. What's living there?

title: Five slow breaths
detail: Breathe in for four counts and out for six, five times.

title: Glass of water
detail: Pour a glass of water and drink it sitting down.

title: Look far away
detail: Look at something at least twenty feet away for twenty seconds.

title: Unclench
detail: Notice your jaw and shoulders. Let them go.

title: One good thing
detail: Name one thing that went well today, however small.

title: Send it
detail: Send one message you've been meaning to send.

title: Clear one surface
detail: Tidy a single shelf, corner or tabletop.

title: Walk to a window
detail: Stand up, walk to a window and look out for a minute.

title: Ask a question
detail: Ask someone a question you don't know the answer to — and listen.

title: Six words
detail: Describe today in exactly six words.
